newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Saudi Iron and Steel Co signs $1.26 bln loan.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Iron and Steel Co signs $1.26 bln loan.

text.p: Saudi Iron and Steel Company, known as Hadeed, said it signed on Tuesday a 4.725 billion riyal ($1.26 billion) bank loan to finance an expansion scheme.

"Hadeed today (Tuesday) signed an agreement with a consortium of local, Gulf and international financial institutions to secure a 4.725 billion riyal loan to finance a major expansion programme," it said in a statement.
Hadeed, owned by industrial giant Saudi Basic Industries used to finance the construction of a flat steel project.
Construction of the new plant has already begun at the firm's complex in the Saudi industrial city of Jubail.
It said 750 million riyals would be used to finance the construction of a new direct reduction module that would supply the raw material for the flat steel plant.
